row.notes: New row (hireEZ, formerly Hiretual). The only public price is the single-user Solo plan at $494/mo (monthly, 7-day trial); any multi-user team buys Enterprise through sales, so SCIM can only be bought through a Contact Sales tier. SCIM evidence comes only from the Okta Integration Network: the hireEZ app (last updated Nov 2023) has SAML and SCIM checked with Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push. hireEZ publishes no SCIM, SSO-setup or API documentation (full help-centre export, 55 articles: 0 SCIM matches; one sign-in article mentions SSO). Status and plan gate are inferred from the pricing structure plus the IdP page, so confidence is low. Not in the Entra gallery (hireez-tutorial 404). Enterprise admins can bulk-invite users by CSV.
